message.reasoning_content:
need to identify crimes based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: theft of oil (原油) from pipeline, theft of vehicle, arson (fire set causing damage), possibly illegal possession of stolen property, and maybe dangerous goods theft. The main crime is theft (盗窃罪) of oil, which is a public or private property? Oil from pipeline likely state-owned, so theft of state property. Also theft of vehicle (面包车) valued 21065元, also theft. Also arson causing damage to transformer, electric equipment, vehicle. That could be "放火罪" (arson) or "故意毁坏财物罪". Since fire caused damage to property, could be "放火罪" if intent to set fire. They set fire inadvertently? It says "在向车内抽送原油时发生着火，并将面包车、1617号变压器、配电房内的电表及电线等烧毁". It seems fire occurred during operation, not necessarily intentional. Could be "过失火灾罪" (negligent fire). But they used heating device, maybe reckless. Likely "放火罪" if they intentionally set fire to cover theft. However text says "发生着火" not "放火". Might be "非法占有为目的，秘密窃取公私财物" => theft. Also "非法占有为目的，盗窃原油" => theft. Also "盗窃车辆" => theft. Also "非法占有为目的，盗窃原油" could be "非法占有国家财产罪"? But theft of state property is still theft. Also "非法占有为目的，盗窃原油" could be "非法占有为目的的盗窃罪" (same). Also "非法占有为目的，盗窃原油" could be "非法占有国家资源罪"? Not typical.

Thus likely crimes: 盗窃罪; 盗窃车辆罪 (but that's also theft). In Chinese law, theft of motor vehicle is also theft. So just theft. Also "放火罪" or "过失毁灭财物罪". The fire caused damage to transformer, electric equipment, vehicle. If they set heating device causing fire, could be "放火罪". The fact they used heating device to melt oil, maybe reckless. I'd include "放火罪". Also "非法占有为目的的盗窃罪" is just theft.

Thus answer: [罪名]盗窃罪;放火罪<eoa>

Check if any other crimes: "非法占有为目的，盗窃原油" could be "非法占有国家资源罪"? Not typical. Also "非法占有为目的，盗窃原油" could be "非法占有公私财物罪"? That's theft. So final.
